findings.evidence: Heading level jumped from 2 (Open the test console) to 4 (Check the sidebar updated) with no intermediate level between them.
findings.fix: Insert a level 3 heading between Open the test console and Check the sidebar updated, or promote Check the sidebar updated to level 3.
findings.location: the Check the sidebar updated heading
findings.violation: This heading is nested more than one level deeper than the heading immediately before it, so a reader or a tool relying on heading level cannot reconstruct which section this one belongs under.

findings.evidence: After the action "Click Trigger sample alert and wait for the status indicator to change to Sent," the next sentence is "The status indicator takes a few seconds to update while the delivery pipeline processes the event in the background," which explains the underlying mechanism rather than instructing the learner on the next action.
findings.fix: Move the explanatory sentence outside the main step sequence, either as a note after all steps are complete, or integrate it into the step instruction itself (e.g., "Click Trigger sample alert and wait a few seconds for the status indicator to change to Sent (the delivery pipeline processes events in the background).")
findings.location: Between the "Trigger the sample alert" section and the "Check the delivery log" section
findings.violation: This explanatory prose pauses the action sequence to describe why the system behaves a certain way, interrupting the concrete, guided sequence of actions a learner is meant to perform.
